arguments.analyst: Observed O rows show the best measured pair O1 I47V:I161V at 4.03, with O3 3.92, O8 (D210E:M233V) 3.79 and O6 (T97S:I229V) 3.78, so conservative two-edit pairs can score well above the ~3.56 menu cluster; low outliers (O4, O5 ~1.30) show that bulkier/non-conservative combos can collapse brightness. Menu entries carrying I229T are the closest analogs to the favorable I229V evidence, and M233V/M233T variants align with O8.
arguments.hypothesis: Conservative two-edit combinations that include a substitution at position 229 (I229T) or 233 (M233V/M233T) will score at or above the ~3.56 menu baseline, mirroring the favorable O6 (I229V) and O8 (M233V) observations.
